subject: Banking
title: Stripe: The Invisible Bank
description: A quick, practical guide to Stripe: The Invisible Bank.

hook.text: Stripe processes payments for millions of businesses. You've probably used it today without knowing.

buildup.text: Stripe lets any business accept online payments with just seven lines of code.

discovery.text: Stripe earns 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. On $1 trillion in annual volume, that's over $30 billion in gross revenue.

twist.text: Stripe is building banking infrastructure. Treasury and Issuing let any platform operate like a bank without a license.

climax.text: Stripe doesn't compete with banks. It makes it easy for everyone else to compete with banks.

punchline.text: Seven lines of code. $65 billion company. Stripe is banking's invisible layer.

quiz.question: What does Stripe enable with seven lines of code?
options: Any business to accept online payments
